brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Portugal defeated Norway 2-1 in a Nations League match, with Ramos scoring the winning goal after Ronaldo was benched. [1][2]

KEY RISKS
Portugal's net energy import dependency of 65% exposes the country to supply disruptions and price volatility. [E3]
Portugal is linked to 3 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, which may pose legal and reputational risks for entities operating in the country. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
The flu outbreak at a southern Portugal care home may lead to further health investigations or policy responses. [3][4]
